messages:
alex: Noticed a billing/quotas discrepancy: requests from frontend using delegated tokens are showing up under the SA owner project in the usage dashboard.
sam: Repro steps? token type and headers?
alex: POST /v1/chat with `Authorization: Bearer exch-123` and `X-Delegated-Project: proj-frontend` — dashboard shows sa-owner-project.
devon: Router currently prefers token principal for SA tokens; exchange tokens weren’t included initially. Exchange claims are verifiable now.
sam: We should avoid breaking existing contracts. Proposed: behind a feature flag, resolve effective_project from exchange claim when `proof_verified=true`, otherwise fallback to token owner.
alex: Telemetry first: emit `auth.attribution.mismatch` and `auth.effective_project` tags.
devon: I'll add audit log `resolved_attribution` behind FF and a metric for exchange token usage. ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-3012 created: attribution FF + telemetry + console toggle.
sam: UX: expose opt-in org setting and show both "Displayed project" and "Resolved billing project" in quota table.
alex: Rollout: 2w telemetry, small canary orgs, then opt-in. Good to proceed on FF PRs.
devon: On it.
ops-bot: Reminder: allocate 30d log retention for FF audit logs.
